SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as trip_count,
  ROUND(SUM(yt) / NULLIF(SUM(anglers), 0), 3) as yt_per_angler,
  ROUND(AVG(yt), 1) as avg_yt_per_trip
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 6
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, cls
LIMIT 100;

SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as trip_count,
  ROUND(SUM(yt) / NULLIF(SUM(anglers), 0), 3) as yt_per_angler,
  ROUND(AVG(yt), 1) as avg_yt_per_trip
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 6
  AND fish_date_doy >= 100
  AND fish_date_doy <= 160
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, cls;

SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  cls,
  ROUND(SUM(yt) / NULLIF(SUM(anglers), 0), 3) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 6
  AND fish_date_doy > 150
  AND fish_date_doy <= 250
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy;
